name: boomerang
description: Hand work from Claude Code to Codex in Herdr before Claude hits its usage limit, and back again after the reset

switch_mode.title: Switch mode
switch_mode.description: confirm: open Codex and wait for you. auto: start Codex at once. notify: only save the handoff and tell you.

five_hour_threshold.title: 5-hour limit threshold (%)
five_hour_threshold.description: Start the handoff when 5-hour usage reaches this percentage

seven_day_threshold.title: 7-day limit threshold (%)
seven_day_threshold.description: Start the handoff when 7-day usage reaches this percentage

codex_placement.title: Codex placement
codex_placement.description: split: a pane beside Claude. tab: a new tab in the same workspace.

codex_args.title: Extra Codex arguments
codex_args.description: Added when Codex starts, for example: --sandbox workspace-write

hand_back.title: Hand back to Claude
hand_back.description: When Codex finishes and Claude's limit has reset, tell Claude to read the Codex report and continue. Off: only notify.
